player_prompt.intro:
Yɔu ye wɛ̈tɛ̈ {player_id} ɣɔn Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Ŋɛ̈n yɔu tɛ̈n, yɔu cɔl tɛ̈ 'X' kɛn 'O' ɣɔn cɛl kuɔ̈t.
Yɔu wɛ̈c naŋ ɣɔn tɛ̈ kuɔ̈t ŋɛ̈n tɛ̈ (X kɛn O) ɣɔn tɛ̈n.
Yɔu cɔl wɛ̈c ɣɔn kuɔ̈t ŋɛ̈n.
Cɔl yɔu tɛ̈ kuɔ̈t naŋ '[X 4]' ɣɔn X ɣɔn cɛl kuɔ̈t.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Cɔlɔ lɛ̈kɛ̈ kɔc. Yakɔl '[X 4]' kɛn '[O 2]' lɛ̈kɛ̈.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nombre ti cell so ayeke na lege ni ape: {cell} A lingbi a duti na popo 0 nga 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: A yeke na lege ni pëpe. Zendo {cell} ayeke dä awe.

game_action.placed: Wɛ̈tɛ̈ {player_id} acɔl tɛ̈ ŋɛ̈thɛ̈ ({mark}) ɣɔn cɛl {cell}

outcome.draw: A sara match ni na lege ti kpongo zo oko pëpe!
